## Findings refused or left open

- ወልዲ / ዘመዲ / ወውሉዲ read as 'his': CONFIRMED, not changed in /. -ዲ cannot be 1cs (that is -የ); 3ms after a consonant is -ሁ > -ዱ, so -ዲ is a variant of -ዱ, as the house entries already say. Only the note's wrong label was fixed (u2).
- ፸ወ፯ ነፍስ = 77 souls: kept. Additive numeral reading is secure; the figure differs from Genesis 46:27 (70) and the LXX (75) and the note already says so. Not a drafter error.
- ፷፼: arithmetic 600,000 is certain; the spoken Geʿez (ስሳ ትእልፊት) cannot be verified without Dillmann, so hedged, not replaced. 'sǝssa' changed to 'sǝsa' (house romanization is per sign).
- አጥረየ: meaning unverifiable; left as 'acquired(?)' with 'gathered' named as an alternative. i in u3 now carries (?).
- ተረግዘ, ተበዊሖ, አብድንተ, አያተ, ዕንቡዛን, ሕቡላን, ዑቅኬ, ተገንዘ: lexemes unverifiable; already (?); kept, no better reading available.
- ተቀነወ: 'nailed' restored on the strength of the house entry and the Passion series, not Dillmann; the earlier part's use is not shown to me in context. Pass 2 should confirm.
- Proper names in l are in English (Isaac, Jacob), whereas conventions say Geʿez form in l: not changed; used consistently and the pilot is not in my reading list. Query for pass 2.
- ፈርሀ 'stood in awe of' (u13 i) vs 'feared' in l: refused; ፈርሀ covers fear/revere and the note says so.
- u2 length (59 words, no internal ፤): refused; no cut point exists.
- ተአዛዜ as an accusative predicate, ተሣይጦ, ዘየኀትሙ (ዘ as conjunction), ባሕቲታ for Christ: grammar judged defensible and already hedged where needed.
- Pass 2 should check: ካዕበ is 'again/also' elsewhere in the part (u3, u14 fine); the build's morph output for the changed glosses; ተዐውቀ's tense.

# Review, pass 2 — kebra-nagast-ch112

Fresh independent check of every unit, every gloss entry and everything pass 1 changed. Dillmann was not open (lexical points stay hedged). t untouched: the concatenation of all t is identical to the pre-pass-2 file (u6 was cut in two at a ፤, text unchanged). Edits by script. Unit numbers below are the new numbering (u6 is now u6 + u7; old u7-u15 are now u8-u16).

## Verified (no change needed)

- ተቀነወ 'nailed': CONFIRMED. The house entry says 'nailed'; ቀነወ with ቅንዋት 'nails' is the piercing/nailing verb, and 'serve' belongs to the different verb ቀነየ. It fits the series bound / nailed / pierced(?). The restoration stands; the broadening is correctly absent.
- -ዲ = 3ms: CONFIRMED in every occurrence (ወልዲ u3, u13, u14, u15; ዘመዲ; ወውሉዲ). The narrator speaks of Jacob's, Joseph's, Isaac's son; 1cs would be -የ and the text uses -የ for Jacob's own speech (አበውየ, ሞትየ). Pass 1's refusal was right.
- ተቤዘዎ = 3ms ተቤዘወ + -ሁ: CONFIRMED (3mp + him would be ተቤዘውዎ).
- No invented word form remains as a lemma, except the guessed ዋርስ in the known entry for መዋርስቲሁ; that entry is not ours to rewrite, so it is broadened with an honest note (below). The other (?) lemmas are existing words with hedged senses.

## Findings refused or left open

- Proper names in l (Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Joseph, Judas, Egypt ...) are in conventional English, not Geʿez form. NOT CHANGED. The pilot ch. 1, which conventions name as the model of register, puts conventional English in l (Zion, Adam, David, Christ, Satan); its l never uses a Geʿez-form name (Krǝstos, Dawit, Ṣǝyon). Converting this part alone would make it inconsistent with every published part. The convention sentence is ambiguous against the pilot; this is an OPEN QUESTION FOR THE OWNER (rule on l: pilot English, or Geʿez transliteration throughout).
- Pass 1 left ተአዛዜ as accusative: confirmed (ተአዛዚ + a gives -ዜ, like ዓቃቤ).
- ፸ወ፯ = 77: kept (additive reading secure; the figure's divergence is already noted).
- ተቤዘዎ given as passive in i against an active l: kept; the subject is unstated and n says so.
- 'so this too shows' (u5 i): kept; the Geʿez leaves an 'as ... ' hanging and a fragment is not English.
- 'take them with you, and gather up my bones' (u16 i): kept; the elided object of ንሥኡ is the bones.
- ካዕበ as 'also' in i against 'again' in l: kept, covered by the new broadening.
- ተዐውቀ 'was made known': kept; the house entry says 'it is known' but its own gloss allows 'was/has become known'. Tense checked: a perfect in a past narrative.
- ዋርስ (guessed lemma), ተረግዘ, ተበዊሖ, አብድንተ, አያተ, ዕንቡዛን, ሕቡላን, ዑቅኬ, ተገንዘ, አጥረየ, በአምርሕተ, ወደቅ: unverifiable without Dillmann; all carry (?).
